violations.why: measure2 ISR (prio 3) can preempt measure1 between the increment and the read, resetting tickCounter.
communicate ISR (prio 5) can preempt measure1 between the increment and the read, resetting tickCounter.
measure2 can reset tickCounter between measure1's read and its write of 0.
communicate can write tickCounter between measure1's read and write.
communicate ISR can preempt measure2 between its write and the check, changing tickCounter.
communicate can reset numberOfRecords after measure1 used it as index and before the increment, so the increment is lost and the record is stored at the wrong index.
communicate can reset intervalCounter between measure1's read and write in the increment, so the reset is lost.
